what_to_decide: Claim 1: "A 0-to-60 result reports the elapsed time for velocity to change from 0 to 60 mph." The NASA page never mentions cars. Claim 3: comparing two cars — same start and end velocity, shorter time means greater average acceleration.
Claim 4: a 0–60 time supports an average over the interval, not acceleration at every instant.
